trans-unit.source: Each row needs to represent one set containing the features and the label. Seperate items with a comma (spaces before and after the comma are okay). The single last item always represents the label while the items before it represent the features. Make sure to use only dots and no commas for floating point values. Si data in forma CSV habes, hic ea infigere potes, sed commentationes remove.
